info.title: Lost and Found API
info.description:
API for managing lost and found items with user authentication, email verification, 
and item tracking capabilities.

tags.name: Utility
tags.description: Health check and server status endpoints

tags.name: Authentication
tags.description: User registration, login, and password management

message.example: User registered successfully. Please check your email to verify your account.

get.description: Verify user's email address using the token sent via email

message.example: Email verified successfully! You can now log in.

post.description: Authenticate user and return JWT token
Send password reset link to user's email

message.example: Password reset link sent to your email

post.description: Reset user password using token from email
